reviews.title: The Best Christian App For Devotion > Device!
reviews.text: I have been using the Bible Mode app for over 3 months now, and I can confidently say that it is the best app-blocking app that reinforces scripture and prayer time over screen time. It has helped me so much with my screen time self-control, and has reduced my screen time by 1 1/2 hours! To unlock your apps, there are many choices you can choose from, including scanning your physical bible, doing a quick devotional, playing a biblical quiz game, or having a custom set quiet time with God. I also love the chat features, where you can look things up about the bible, or for example ‘tell me about the key principles of Jesus’s parables.” It responds right away, giving factual information STRAIGHT from the Bible! I would give this app 6 stars if I could, I am truly grateful that I have this app, and most importantly Jesus! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.title: Bible Mode helps me give God my first and best
reviews.text:
Update added: I have been using Bible Mode now for 375 consecutive days. And wow, I crave time in God’s word, in prayer, and playing Bible Mode games. The quiz and trivia feature has helped me retain knowledge. I’ve recently enjoyed the audio feature. This app has given me accountability in my desire to spend more time with Jesus over social media and scrolling mindlessly. I cannot recommend Bible Mode enough. 

Original Review: Bible Mode has truly helped me stay focused on God and His Word daily instead of getting caught up in social media and other distractions that aren’t meant for me or my time. I love the chat feature as it’s been such a helpful way to process my thoughts through a biblical lens. Having the ability to ask for quick reference guides when I’m studying or searching for something specific has also made my time with the Lord more meaningful and intentional. I look forward to more features being added and hope to see bible study plans happen! Thank you, Bible Mode!

reviews.title: The BEST app you can get!
reviews.text:
This app has quite literally changed my life. I used to sit for hours on end, scrolling on social media, telling myself, “After this video you can read your bible”. Only to, of course, put off spending time with the Lord for a few more hours just so I could have extra screen time. 
I downloaded this app in hopes that i would simply have something that would prevent me from going on to social media, and not even allow me the chance to scroll. I didn’t want to just limit my screen time on my phone, because i can press ‘15 more minutes’ thirty more times and keep scrolling!!

This app works perfectly because it forces you to spend time in His Word before anything. What i love about it most, is that you don’t just have to read your bible. This app offers mini games such as a biblical version of Wordle (my favorite), trivia, word searches and so much more. By the time i have completed one of these games, i forgot that I even wanted to scroll. There are also options to snap a picture of your bible in person, or read daily devotions instead. It’s not only fun, but I’m also memorizing scripture and learning new things about the bible instead of scrolling. 

If your someone like me, where setting a screen time limit just doesn’t work, then I would definitely recommend this app. You can spend time with the Lord in place of social media, and keep your Bible Word streak running strong! (I’m currently at 23! 🔥) 

If the publishers of this app ever wanted to promote this on every platform, boy would I! That’s how much I love it.
